known_retrieval_blocker: The duration and decile trajectory TSVs are large UTF-16 text files. The current GitHub text connector rejects their blobs as non-UTF-8 and returns empty content through ranged file reads. They remain pending rather than being counted as ingested; their immutable blob SHAs and sizes stay inventoried for a byte-capable retrieval path.
